selection_rule: Precommitted P11 public task selection: next four previously unexposed train scenarios in sorted ID order, variant _1; never replace based on outcomes.
server_lease_basis: Identical server command restarted after P10 complete and empty model slot; bounded --max-seconds14400. Per-trial evaluation180sec plus180sec reserve, no start below8100sec remaining.
scope: Existing FOCUS-based adaptation on same four development tasks, with a certified retention early exit. One seed, no original-score reproduction or new-method claim.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Same original task, model, public API discovery, executor prompt, budgets and task order as P11/P12.
Memory drafts have temperature0.7 and at most3 calls; executor temperature1.0. Role-specific seed schedules already separate memory and agent roles.
Citations from at least ceil(3*0.3)=1 draft and rescued observations are retained. Any selected operation retains its original whole response group.
Stop drafting only when all visible spans are already guaranteed retained, including invalid-future-output fallback. This is a conventional safe shortcut, not novelty.
Public API schemas currently visible to the executor are also supplied as inert data to the memory role and fully charged. Only submit_selection is callable by that role.
The 4096-token history proxy triggers at most one update before each agent call. Selection has no forced size target; unchanged or oversized memory still counts.
Malformed drafts keep original history. Exhausted budget or model failures stop; all costs are retained. No real environment action is replayed by the memory role.
All four tasks remain included regardless of P11/P12 outcomes; source code and conditions are frozen before the first P13 generation.
history_representation: Original native turns remain archived. FOCUS selects visible spans and whole-turn closure preserves requests/results. The original task and externally exposed API schemas remain available. Raw observations can be re-read using read_span.
